scripts.build:shared: npm -w @concertable/b2b run build && npm -w @concertable/web-b2b run build
scripts.build:artist: npm run build:shared && npm -w @concertable/web-artist run build
scripts.build:venue: npm run build:shared && npm -w @concertable/web-venue run build
scripts.build:business: npm run build:shared && npm -w @concertable/web-business run build
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared && npm -w @concertable/web-admin run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm -w @concertable/web-artist run build && npm -w @concertable/web-venue run build && npm -w @concertable/web-business run build && npm -w @concertable/web-admin run build
scripts.typecheck:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm -w @concertable/mobile-b2b exec -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:mobile: npm run typecheck:mobile && npm -w @concertable/mobile-b2b exec -- expo export --platform android
